# CoCache

> Level 2 Distributed Coherence Cache Framework for Java/Kotlin. Two-level caching (L2 bounded local Caffeine + L1 distributed Redis) with event-driven coherence via CacheEvictedEventBus and bounded staleness.

## Documentation

- [Wiki](wiki/llms.txt) — Complete wiki with onboarding guides, architecture, API reference, and module documentation

## Key Concepts

- **Two-Level Caching**: L2 (local in-memory) → L1 (distributed Redis) → L0 (DataSource); storage tiers are pure stores, TTL policy (`TtlPolicy`) lives in the orchestration layer
- **Cache Coherence**: Event-driven via CacheEvictedEventBus (Redis Pub/Sub or in-process LocalCacheEvictedEventBus); every write-back is guarded by invalidation stamps; L2 is cleared on every channel (re)subscription (`onReset`)
- **Annotation-Driven**: @CoCache (ttl 3600s, ttlAmplitude 60s, missingTtl 60s by default), @CaffeineCache, @JoinCacheable
- **Proxy-Based**: JDK dynamic proxies create cache implementations from annotated interfaces
- **JoinCache**: Compose multiple cached values into a single JoinValue result
- **Cache Stampede Prevention**: Per-key SingleFlight load coalescing (original exceptions shared with waiters)
- **Cache Penetration Prevention**: Explicit negative cache (sealed `CacheValue` = `PresentValue` | `MissingValue`) with its own `missingTtl` + optional BloomKeyFilter
- **TTL Jitter**: Randomized TTL within amplitude bounds prevents cache avalanche
- **Failure Degradation**: Redis read failures fall back to source (strict mode via `cocache.redis.strict-failure`); an L1 miss is never treated as a negative cache; corrupted payloads self-heal

## Architecture

Modules:
- `cocache-api` — User API and all SPI (Cache, CacheValue, CacheStore/ClientSideCache/DistributedCache, CacheSource, KeyConverter, KeyFilter, CacheEvictedEventBus, JoinCache)
- `cocache-core` — Orchestration and defaults (DefaultCoherentCache, TtlPolicy, SingleFlight, Caffeine L2, proxies, JoinCache)
- `cocache-spring` — Spring integration (@EnableCoCache, factory beans)
- `cocache-spring-redis` — Redis implementation (RedisDistributedCache, RedisCacheEvictedEventBus, codecs)
- `cocache-spring-cache` — Spring Cache abstraction bridge (CoCacheManager, CoSpringCache)
- `cocache-spring-boot-starter` — Auto-configuration and Actuator endpoints
- `cocache-test` — TCK test specifications

## Build

```bash
./gradlew build -x test    # Build without tests
./gradlew check             # Full check (tests + detekt + dokka)
./gradlew test              # Run all tests
./gradlew :cocache-core:test  # Module-specific tests
```

- JDK 17+, Gradle 9.7.0, Kotlin 2.4.10
- Group: `me.ahoo.cocache`, Version: `5.0.0`
- Design and invariants: `docs/architecture.md`
